resolution.note: worker brief and task-keyed query write exposure rows with served, withheld and task; effect counts them; test red on base by assertion, green after

title: Worker packets and advisory checks record served and withheld standards like the lead session
body:
Source: Astra B2/B3 (.krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-rerun-verdicts.md); t-vgwc1an (#1374, 1ed42b5) fixed only Stop refusals. src/brain/worker-packet.ts:68 and src/cli/standards-cli.ts:275 still write packets and advisory checks without served/withheld records, so worker exposures are invisible to standards effect and retire.
Outcome: a worker packet writes one exposure row with served and withheld record ids and the task id; standards effect counts them; a test asserts the row for a captured worker brief exits 0.
Proof: the new test fails before the fix by assertion and passes after.
Files: src/brain/worker-packet.ts, src/cli/standards-cli.ts, test/brain/worker-packet.test.ts
